tier_should.rationale: Important systematic review/meta-analysis on lead and learning in LMICs; adjusts for confounding and publication bias and triangulates with natural experiments. Strong policy relevance and synthesis quality, though causality limits remain. Suitable for top field journals in development/health.

tier_will.rationale: Meta-analyses face skepticism in top economics outlets; reliance on observational studies and the messy abstract reduce perceived credibility. More likely to land in strong field journals in development, education, or environmental health than A-journals.
